assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of recurrent syncope and palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other cardiac arrhythmias.
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered.
The monitoring is ordered to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances and correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings over an extended monitoring period.
The monitoring supports medical necessity under diagnosis I49.9.
The monitoring supports medical necessity under diagnosis I48.91.
The monitoring supports medical necessity under diagnosis R55.
